objective: Fix the benchmark pass hard wall timeout so the original deadline remains active through all repair turns; add CPU regression coverage; make the isolated TaskFlow runner cancel at max-wait; validate Linux build/tests; only then rerun TaskFlow ULTRA MTP-off then MTP-on serially on the Q79-pinned Qwen3.8-Flash-Next eval profiles.
hypothesis: finalize() destroys the pass-level hard timeout before scheduling repair, leaving active repair turns without the intended app-level wall-clock deadline; the Q79 runner recorded max-wait but required an external cancellation call.

scope.gpu_comparison: TaskFlow ULTRA only; MTP-off then MTP-on, serially, copied from Q79 pins

methods: Use a pure policy helper in production to decide whether a scheduled repair keeps the pass hard timeout armed; test retry and terminal outcomes in the existing CPU Qt suite.
Copy Q79 TaskFlow runner into Q81, preserving fingerprints and timeout settings; add API cancellation at max-wait and bounded finalization/owned-service cleanup.
Run ./scripts/build-linux.sh Debug and ./scripts/tests-linux.sh Release; record exact outputs, exit codes, source and binary SHA-256.
Only after CPU gates and sheet readback, perform a fresh host/model/preflight fingerprint gate and execute each TaskFlow arm serially.
success_criteria: Hard timeout covers initial turn and every repair from one unchanged start timestamp; retries do not reset or remove it.
Regression verifies that repair keeps the timer and terminal finalization stops it.
Runner sends cancelBenchmark at 1860 seconds and verifies benchmarkRunning=false within a finite finalization grace; Q81-only process cleanup is verified.
Linux Debug build and Linux Release test suite exit 0.
Each GPU arm is fingerprint-matched, full-coverage, safely finalized and postflight-clean; incomplete arm gets no comparative score.
stop_conditions: CPU test or build gate fails.
Sheet readback, artifact fingerprint, profile, suite, model path or binary check differs.
External inference server or PeritoSoft is active and cannot be safely distinguished/closed; resource guard fails; OOM changes; or service cleanup is incomplete.
1800-second inference timeout or 1860-second runner max-wait; then cancel, bounded finalization, stop only Q81-owned service if required, record incomplete, no score.
no_adoption_rule: No model/profile/productive default change from Q79 or one Q81 matched pair. ASTRA/SOL, GUI, existing weights and profiles are preserved.
